schema_file.description: Path to the schema file (YAML or JSON) used for validation.

data_file.description: Path to the data file (YAML or JSON) to be validated.

parse_module.description: Perl module to use for parsing. Valid values: YAML, YAML::XS, YAML::Syck, JSON, JSON::XS.

silent.description: If true, suppress standard output when the document is valid.
